sections.changelog:
Added

  • Review post type `mvweb_review` (private, no public URLs) with the `mvweb_review_group` taxonomy.
  • Review fields: rating, city, ordered service, work photos, company reply, pinning, source and source URL.
  • Moderation through the native pending/publish statuses, bulk actions and a pending counter in the menu.
  • Visitor form shortcode `[mvweb_review_form]` with honeypot, minimum fill time, per-IP limit, optional contact, photo upload and consent checkbox.
  • Output shortcode `[mvweb_reviews]` with grid, carousel, list and accordion layouts and per-block attribute overrides.
  • Clamped review text with a “Read in full” toggle, initials placeholder instead of a missing photo, work photo lightbox on ``, carousel on CSS scroll-snap, AJAX “Show more”.
  • Summary rating block and JSON-LD output attached to the Yoast SEO or Rank Math organization node.
  • Import of reviews pasted from a map service, CSV import and CSV export.
  • Settings page on MVweb Admin UI Kit with General, Appearance, Form, Markup, Import and Help tabs.
  • Shortcode button for the classic editor.
  • Transient cache for rendered blocks, cleared on any review or settings change.
  • Russian translation.
  • License check against the update server: a signed `revoked`/`domain_mismatch` verdict closes the settings page and blocks new imports; a missing key, an unreachable server or an unsigned verdict never block anything. License key field and status on the Help tab, `MVWEB_LICENSE_KEY` in `wp-config.php` takes priority over it.
